before.prompt_text:
REFERENCE PRESENT: The attached person/persons are authoritative. Preserve every person's recognizable facial identity, age, facial structure, distinguishing facial characteristics, skin tone, ethnicity, natural body proportions and hairline. Preserve the number and identity of people in couple/group references. Never copy the preview model's face, complexion or identity. The preview supplies styling, pose, expression, wardrobe, composition, lighting and environment only. Cultural settings and styles, including K-drama, European editorial and retro Bollywood, do not determine ethnicity. Hair may be adapted when essential to the requested transformation; preserve the hairline and recognizable identity. Otherwise preserve or gently arrange the existing hair colour, length and texture.

NO REFERENCE PRESENT: Default to an appropriate fictional Indian/South Asian adult woman. Use believable diversity in Indian appearance, complexion, age and hair, with ordinary natural proportions; do not repeat a stereotypical face. Match age and number only where essential to this concept. Without a source photo, this is a newly generated illustrative example, not an edit or authentic restoration of someone's photograph. A faithful edit requires the original image.

CREATIVE DIRECTION:

Change only the outfit of the person in the supplied photograph into a tailored terracotta pantsuit over an ivory blouse. Preserve identity, age, skin tone, hairstyle, expression, body proportions, pose, accessories and background. Keep the original face and hair pixels as close to the source as the editing tool allows.

Appearance: Preserve the uploaded person’s hair, parting, expression, skin tone and facial identity. Do not copy the preview model’s face or change the person’s age.

Pose and expression: Keep the existing body pose, head angle, hands, background and crop. Fit the new clothes to the original body rather than reshaping the body to fit the clothes.

Essential visible details: Tailored terracotta blazer with notched lapels and matching straight wide-leg trousers over an ivory blouse; believable seams, waistband, cloth folds and hand openings. Retain existing jewellery and other accessories.

Preserve original framing unless a headshot crop is requested; never invent unseen body parts to fit a new crop. Output aspect ratio: preserve the source aspect ratio and framing. Do not crop, extend the canvas or invent unseen body parts unless the user explicitly requests a new crop. An optional 4:5 version requires that explicit request and a separate composition check. Source-preserving instructions override preview camera, lighting and framing suggestions. Keep natural texture and plausible edges; avoid beauty smoothing, halos, added text or watermarks.

REFERENCE COMPATIBILITY: Preserve the reference age and all intended group identities. If a child, infant, maternity or group-specific concept conflicts with the supplied people, ask for suitable complete references rather than changing age, inventing pregnancy or replacing anyone.
